description.value: Pinhalla is a one-of-a-kind pinball arcade and pizzeria tucked inside a heritage merchant warehouse at the base of Canada's oldest Chinatown in Victoria. The 100-seat venue pairs New York/Sicilian-style pizza and locally brewed craft beer with a hall of 35+ vintage and modern pinball machines. It runs a weekly pinball league, trivia nights, and DJ events, making it a lively stop for cyclists looking for a full meal and entertainment in the heart of downtown.

No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
